Reading: a +20% step usually costs ~+5% CPI and ~−0.5 pp D1 → Ret CPI ~+6–7%; installs +15%. A cut gives back less than it took (−15% budget ≈ −4% CPI). That is why budget moves in small steps and only where the 7-day read has headroom.

5. If CPI rises – the alternative plan (keep volume, protect Ret CPI; in this order)
Blended 3d Ret CPI > ₹23 (1.1× guard) for 2 days, or 7d > ₹21
No raises anywhere. Keep budgets; do not cut on the first bad days.
3-day moves often reverse (weekends, festivals). The 7-day read decides.
CPI stops climbing from new budget; volume unchanged.
Move 10–15% of spend from ad sets / campaigns > 1.3× target to section-2 entities on ANY platform (Google DT is limited by budget; ShareChat Moj 30s / DT 30s are at ₹11–12).
Same rupees buy installs where the Ret CPI is lower; total volume is protected.
Blended Ret CPI −4% to −8% in 3–5 days; installs flat or up.
An ad's 7d Ret CPI +25% vs the week before with 3d worse (fatigue)
2–3 new cuts of the same show per fatiguing ad (new 3-second hooks, 2-min and 30s versions). Unlimited pool – rotate weekly.
Fatigue is the most common cause of CPI creep in a stable auction; a new hook resets attention for the same audience.
Ad-set Ret CPI back to its earlier level within 3–5 days; CTR +10–20%.
